answers.core: This is about making the built-in font editing experience easier to use, and more on par with the font picking dialogs of other programs, which are what many users have come to expect.
answers.workaround: It could be potentially worked around with an editor plugin, in a complicated, hack-y sort of way. It definitely would not be a few lines of script, though.

title: Display font previews in the inspector when loading system fonts
